name: ARANEA DIADEMA
key_symptoms: Cramps after eating a little; epigastrium painful to pressure.
Pain in intercostal nerve from nerve endings to spine. Bright red hćmorrhage from lungs (Millefol; Ferr phos).

Pain in right trifacial nerve from periphery inwards. Confusion; better by smoking in open air. Heat and flickering in eyes; worse in damp weather. Sudden violent pain in teeth at night immediately after lying down.
Bone-pains in extremities. Pain in os calcis. Sensation of swelling, and of parts going to sleep.

head_symptoms: Pain in right trifacial nerve from periphery inwards. Confusion; better by smoking in open air. Heat and flickering in eyes; worse in damp weather. Sudden violent pain in teeth at night immediately after lying down.

gi_symptoms: Cramps after eating a little; epigastrium painful to pressure.
urinary_symptoms: Menses too early, too copious. Distention of abdomen. Lumbo-abdominal neuralgia.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Bone-pains in extremities. Pain in os calcis. Sensation of swelling, and of parts going to sleep.
sleep_symptoms: Restless and waking, as if hands and forearms were swollen and heavy.
fever_symptoms: Coldness, with pain in long bones, and feeling of stone in abdomen at the same hour daily. Chilly day and night; always worse during rain.
